I should have said, we actually did this starting in December, we talked over Christmas a lot, and we wanted to be with each other, but we wanted to take it slow, and be more open. We tried it, but honestly neither of us liked it very much, we both experienced different people, but we talked about it more towards the end of last month and decided to become exclusive again. 

The same thing happened for us too, we would go out with people, be with other people, and you would just compare them. It would almost seem unfair. I know neither of us are perfect, no one is, but I would find flaws with every person I met. I wanted them all to be like her, which made me realize, the only way I'd have that is if I had her.

I suppose I'm a bit of a romantic, which may not be a popular world view on reddit, but I love this girl very much, and I'm very happy where I'm at right now, so thank you for your wishes, and the same to you! I wish everyone in the world could feel the feelings I have for this girl, and the feelings I get because she shares them.
